2607.11862.title: Evidence-Backed Video Question Answering
2607.11862.paper_summary: Current Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) excel in question answering (QA) but largely operate as black boxes, providing textual answers without verifiable visual grounding. Existing explainability efforts rely on textual rationales or sparse bounding boxes, which struggle to capture complex video dynamics such as occlusions and non-rigid deformations. We propose Evidence-Backed Video Question Answering (E-VQA), a novel task requiring models to jointly output a semantic answer and precise spatio-temporal evidence: temporal segments and dense, tracked object segmentation masklets. To support this, we introduce ST-Evidence, the first human-verified benchmark for both discriminative and generative pixel-level grounding. Evaluations of state-of-the-art models reveal a critical decoupling between QA accuracy and true visual perception that scaling alone fails to bridge. To address this, we develop scalable, automated generation pipelines to create ST-Evidence-Instruct, a 160k-scale dataset bridging high-level reasoning with fine-grained grounding. Fine-tuning grounded Video LLMs on this data yields substantial gains over the corresponding size-matched UniPixel baselines (e.g., +27.2 t-mean and +13.8 J&F on a 7B model), establishing a robust baseline for explainable, evidence-backed video understanding. Code and data are available at https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/EVQA.
2607.11862.paper_summary_zh: 目前的視頻大型語言模型（Video LLMs）在問答（QA）方面表現優異，但主要作為黑箱運作，提供文本答案而無法驗證的視覺基礎。現有的可解釋性努力依賴於文本理由或稀疏的邊界框，這些方法難以捕捉複雜的視頻動態，例如遮擋和非剛性變形。我們提出了基於證據的視頻問答（E-VQA），這是一項新任務，要求模型共同輸出語義答案和精確的時空證據：時間片段和密集的、跟踪的物體分割掩碼。為了支持這一點，我們引入了ST-Evidence，這是首個經過人工驗證的基準，用於區分和生成像素級的基礎。對最先進模型的評估顯示，QA準確性與真實視覺感知之間存在關鍵的解耦，僅靠擴展無法彌補這一差距。為了解決這個問題，我們開發了可擴展的自動生成管道，以創建ST-Evidence-Instruct，一個規模達到160k的數據集，將高層次推理與細粒度基礎相結合。在這些數據上微調基於證據的視頻LLMs，與相應的大小匹配的UniPixel基準相比，取得了顯著的增益（例如，在7B模型上，t-mean提高了27.2，J&F提高了13.8），為可解釋的、基於證據的視頻理解建立了穩健的基準。代碼和數據可在 https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/EVQA 獲得。
